description: PROPOSED (issue #107 / Discussion #108, not yet normative): Lenient consumption (`mode: allow_unknown`): the same document as unknown_field_resultset_rejected.json is accepted by a validator run with allow_unknown / allowUnknown / --allow-unknown, the opt-in for a consumer reading a document from a newer minor version it does not implement. Only the unknown-field check is relaxed. The raw JSON Schema models strict mode only and rejects this document; an implementation without a lenient mode may skip fixtures that declare `mode`.
